01 Industrial Automation

Instrumentation, controls, and the systems that run the world.

Sixteen years with hands on the instruments. / Capabilities

From the sensor to the control room

It starts at the device. Everything else is built on whether the measurement is telling you the truth.

/ 01

Field Instrumentation

Sensors, transmitters, and control loops for flow, level, temperature, and pressure. Mounted, ranged, commissioned, and verified with hands on the device.

/ 02

Analytical Measurement

pH, conductivity, and process analytics: the measurements that foul, drift, and need someone who knows what the reading is actually reporting.

/ 03

Calibration & Loop Verification

Instrumentation schematics, loop diagrams, and calibration routines that hold up to an audit and keep the loop honest.

/ 04

Motor & Relay Logic

Motor control circuits, relay logic, and burner management modernized with visibility and safeguards, where legacy meets logic.

/ 05

PID & Safety Functions

Advanced PID control and Safety Instrumented Functions designed for stability, repeatability, and the times things go wrong.

/ 06

Control Logic & Troubleshooting

Reading, changing, and troubleshooting the logic running on your PLC and DCS. Custom integration work happens too, scoped to what a specific job needs.

/ Hard problems

The measurement that will not behave

An intermittent reading. A loop that drifts on night shift and nowhere else. A level that is right until the tank gets low. A transmitter that has been replaced twice and still lies to you.

These are the calls we take. Most measurement problems are not instrument failures. They are a process meeting an instrument that was never matched to it: product flashing across an orifice, low-density solids that radar sees straight through, coating, foam, entrained gas, stratification, temperature swings the datasheet never mentioned.

If something is misbehaving right now, instrument technical support lists the symptoms we get called for and where we work. We find out which it is before anyone spends money. Often the instrument you already own is the right one, mounted, ranged, or configured wrong. Sometimes the technology genuinely cannot see your product, and we will tell you that too, with the reasoning behind it.

Intermittent and unrepeatable faultsProblems that behave while someone is watching and return when nobody is.
Hard-to-measure productsFlashing and two-phase flow, low-density solids, foam, slurries, coating and buildup, entrained gas.
Process-induced measurement errorWhere the reading is wrong because of what the process is doing, not because the device has failed.
Repeat failures and serial replacementsThe same device dying again and again is a symptom. We look for what keeps killing it.
Keep it or change it, answered straightWhether the installed technology can be made reliable, or genuinely cannot see your product.
